description: Convert raw HTML markup into clean Markdown (headings, links, tables, lists, fenced code, blockquotes, entities decoded; strips script/style and optional chrome). $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). Call once without `payment` for terms, then pass `payment`.

baseUrl.description: Optional base https:// URL to resolve relative links and images.

html.description: Raw HTML markup to convert to Markdown (up to 512 KB).

stripChrome.description: Optional: set true to omit nav/header/footer/aside/form chrome.

name: html_to_markdown
title: Html to markdown
